card.name: Company and place name endings
card.fires_on: The last word of a proper-name organization or place, such as LLC, Inc, Industries, Ranch or Landing, right after a company or site name.

modes.description: Legal or business ending word after a company name.

modes.label: Place-name endings
modes.description: Generic place word closing a named site, such as a landing, ranch or cottage.
